report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of subprocess_adapter.py, covering __init__, classmethods claude, codex, from_name, capabilities, and create_session. All claims verified against visible code.
risks: create_session | medium | Spawns subprocess with user-controlled command; ensure command is not user-controlled. | Verify that command originates from trusted config.
create_session | medium | Environment variables are inherited from os.environ; may leak secrets. | Confirm that no sensitive env vars are exposed.
create_session | low | session_id uses uuid4 hex[:8] which gives 32-bit collision space; high concurrency may cause collisions. | Evaluate if collision resistance is needed.

handoff.purpose: Define SubprocessAdapter initializer, classmethods for profile-based construction, capabilities, and create_session method.

symbols.name: __init__
symbols.note: Initializes SubprocessAdapter with config, command, args, timeout_s, repo_root, sink, runtime_name.

symbols.name: claude
symbols.note: Classmethod returning SubprocessAdapter for claude profile.

symbols.name: codex
symbols.note: Classmethod returning SubprocessAdapter for codex profile.

symbols.name: from_name
symbols.note: Classmethod returning SubprocessAdapter for a named profile from RUNTIME_PROFILES.

symbols.name: capabilities
symbols.note: Returns AgentCapabilities with streaming/resume from config, hidden_state_access=False.

symbols.name: create_session
symbols.note: Spawns subprocess, creates session, writes prompt via stdin if configured.

claims.text: Either config or command must be provided
claims.why: Code raises ValueError if both config is None and command is falsy.
Code raises ValueError if root.is_dir() is False.

claims.text: from_name raises ValueError for unknown profiles
claims.why: Code checks profile is None and raises ValueError with message.

claims.text: capabilities returns AgentCapabilities with streaming, resume, hidden_state_access
claims.why: AgentCapabilities is constructed with those fields as shown.

claims.text: session cwd must be a directory
claims.why: Code raises ValueError if cwd.is_dir() is False.

claims.text: model_arg required if model is provided
claims.why: Code raises ValueError if model is truthy and self._config.model_arg is falsy.
Code raises ValueError if prompt and prompt_mode == 'none'.
Code appends self._config.stdin_prompt_marker if prompt_mode == 'stdin' and marker exists.

claims.text: prompt is written to stdin if prompt_mode is 'stdin'
claims.why: Code calls _write_stdin with prompt and may close stdin if configured.

claims.text: session_id is generated from command stem and uuid

observations.what: create_session spawns subprocess with asyncio.create_subprocess_exec using user-controlled command and args.
Environment is inherited from os.environ merged with config.env; may expose secrets.
session_id uses only 8 hex chars from uuid4 (32-bit space); collision possible under high concurrency.
